blocks.text: Deuteronomy 13 contains 18 verses. It opens with: If there arise in the midst of thee a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and he give thee a sign or a wonder, It concludes with: when thou shalt hearken to the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The repeated instruction is rhetorically adapted covenant exposition for a successor generation, not a simple verbatim duplication of earlier laws.
